title: Waymo opens robotaxi service in Las Vegas | TechCrunch
summary: Waymo’s fleet and service area will eventually scale. Waymo’s entry into Las Vegas follows approval by the Nevada Transportation Authority to operate commercial robotaxi services in Clark County, home to Las Vegas.
